scheme_name: Alpsankhyak Muslim Parityaqta/Talaqshuda Mahila Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must not have remarried
Widows are not eligible for the scheme
Benefits are available only once in a lifetime
Eligibility category noted in source: Divorced
Eligibility category noted in source: Abandoned by husband for more than 2 years
Eligibility category noted in source: Husband is completely mentally handicapped
benefits_summary: Provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000 to eligible minority Muslim abandoned or divorced women to strengthen their economic condition.
